name: amazon fba fee variance digest

product.purpose: Compare FBA per-unit fulfillment-fee lines in a seller's own Amazon Settlement Report V2 with a seller-supplied expectation by SKU and size tier; estimate variance and margin effect for manual review.
inputs: seller-provided SKU, size-tier, expected-fee, and unit-cost CSV
outputs: local CSV digest with source row, expected and actual fee, estimated variance, and margin estimate
product.data_access: Local CSV files only. No SP-API, Amazon login, scraping, or outbound customer-data transfer.
product.pricing_hypothesis: $49 one-time paid pilot for one report and fee schedule; unvalidated hypothesis.
limitations: expected fee schedule is supplied by the seller
estimates are not guarantees or refund claims
margin omits other costs and fees

your_steps.title: Send the pilot pitch to one business
your_steps.when: When ready to test buyer interest
your_steps.detail: Choose one business lead, personalize and manually send the email in PILOT.md from Anderson Education LLC. Complete the sender signature, business mailing address, and opt-out line before sending. Do not attach reports or request a seller login; ask the prospect to send only their own downloaded CSVs if they accept the pilot.

launch_gates: Never request Amazon credentials or access another seller's account; the pilot uses the seller's own downloaded reports and fee schedule.
Do not promise fee refunds, fee errors, or guaranteed savings; the seller manually verifies each flagged row.
Manually send business outreach only; honor any opt-out and do not automate prospect browsing or email.
